gloss: hot stone bath; hot stone spa

definitions.gloss: hot stone bath; hot stone spa
definitions.explanation: A type of spa treatment where one lies on heated flat stones, typically wearing light clothing, to induce sweating. Believed to have detox and relaxation benefits.

examples.japanese: {岩盤浴|がんばんよく}でたくさん{汗|あせ}をかいた。
examples.english: I sweated a lot in the hot stone bath.

examples.japanese: {岩盤浴|がんばんよく}は{初|はじ}めてだ。
examples.english: This is my first time doing a hot stone bath.

examples.japanese: {岩盤浴|がんばんよく}の{後|あと}は{肌|はだ}がすべすべになる。
examples.english: My skin becomes smooth after a hot stone bath.

notes:
{岩盤浴|がんばんよく} is done wearing provided light clothes ({館内着|かんないぎ}) and lying on heated natural stones. It's a popular amenity at スーパー{銭湯|せんとう} and {健康|けんこう}ランド. Sessions typically last 15-20 minutes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {岩盤浴|がんばんよく}を{楽|たの}しむ (to enjoy hot stone bathing)
- {岩盤浴|がんばんよく}{専用|せんよう}{着|ぎ} (hot stone bath clothing)
- {岩盤浴|がんばんよく}エリア (hot stone bath area)

RELATED WORDS:
- サウナ: sauna
- スーパー{銭湯|せんとう}: super bathhouse
- デトックス: detox
